text:
```yaml
name: Lint and Update Roadmap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint-and-update-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install markdown

    - name: Fetch latest roadmap.md
      run: git fetch origin main

    - name: Append new sections to roadmap.md
      run: |
        echo "## Document Understanding Tasks" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Table Structure Recognition | Extract tables from documents." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Key-Value Extraction | Identify and extract key-value pairs." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Reading Order | Determine the logical reading sequence of elements." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Handwriting | Recognize handwritten text." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Scene Text | Extract text from images or scenes." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Document Classification | Categorize documents into predefined classes." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Multi-Page Context | Understand context across multiple pages." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "| Figure/Chart Awareness | Identify and extract figures and charts." >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "- Realistic Noise"
        echo "- Complex Layouts" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "## Modeling Additions" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "- Quantization Recipes"
        echo "- Confidence Estimation"
        echo "- Serving Example"
        echo "- ONNX/TRT Export"
        echo "- Data Mixing Strategy"
        echo "- Experiment Tracking" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "## Benchmarking Additions" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "- Robustness Benchmarks"
        echo "- Commercial API Comparison"
        echo "- Cross-Dataset Generalization"
        echo "- CI Regression Testing"
        echo "- Failure Mode Taxonomy"
        echo "- Domain-Specific Benchmarks" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "## Developer Experience" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "- Unified CLI"
        echo "- Tutorials"
        echo "- Model Cards"
        echo "- Output Format Interop" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "## Priority Order" >> docs/roadmap.md
        echo "1. Document Understanding Tasks"
        echo "2. Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)"
        echo "3. Modeling Additions"
        echo "4. Benchmarking Additions"
        echo "5. Developer Experience"

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add docs/roadmap.md
        git commit -m "Update roadmap with new tasks, benchmarking, and DX"
        git push origin main
```
